title: skillevaluation eval.yaml (schema rev 2)
description: A declarative A/B test suite for a skill. Lives next to SKILL.md. Rev 2 (ADR-0007): ONE execution contract — the agent is invoked once per case in a prepared workspace, may take many tool steps (max_turns caps them), the whole trajectory is recorded, and grading is expectations (LLM judge over the transcript) + validators (code). The rev-1 mode enum and its per-mode fields (user_goal, environment, simulator, policy_check, per-case trials) are removed; repetition is a runner-level setting (--runs), MEAN-aggregated.

cases.description: Test cases. Each runs twice (with-skill and without-skill).

name.description: Unique identifier for the case within this suite.

prompt.description: The user-message text sent to the agent.

setup.description: Workspace preparation — the case's ENVIRONMENT, as data. Either a list of shell commands (legacy form), or a mapping {files: {relpath: content}, commands: [...]} — files are written into the case workspace BEFORE any command runs (spec 0.3.0).

files.description: Relative path → file content, staged before commands run. Absolute paths and `..` escapes are rejected (same guard as bundled skill files).

commands.description: Shell commands executed after the files are staged.

expectations.description: Natural-language assertions graded by an LLM judge whose evidence is the FULL trajectory transcript (agent actions + final response).

validators.description: Shell-command assertions graded by exit code, run in the case workspace (the agent's final reply is staged as ./response.txt and $RESPONSE_TEXT).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what the case tests.

max_turns.description: Optional cap on the agent's tool-loop steps for this case.

should_trigger.description: Trigger evaluation (spec 0.3.0): true = this prompt SHOULD surface the skill; false = a near-miss that should NOT. A case with should_trigger and no grader is TRIGGER-ONLY — exempt from the grader rule; an A/B runner skips it with disclosure (cases_skipped_trigger_only). Routing is graded by platform-side tooling, not this spec's runner. Composes with graded fields (a case may carry both).

cmd.description: Shell command to execute after the agent runs.

expect_exit_code.description: The exit code that means the validator passed. Default 0.

label.description: Display name. Defaults to first 80 chars of cmd.
